Skill gap depends on bot depth (greedy 18.5/12.3, L2) and comes from general odds estimation, not the hook; 5p and 6p behave differently (L8); 6p last-round flip 25% (L3).

If revised anyway, one change only: make the crash bite (e.g. crashed category loses printed value too); KPI ignore-crash at least +5 at both 5p and 6p with Hype share still 45-50%
Add running crash tie-break total or freeze Hype before round 14; KPI 6p last-round flip at most 20% (now 25%)
State that hands are revealed for tiebreakers and explain or drop round-14 income; KPI zero ambiguities at pitch
